patch_description: Retain the stronger parent's gradual recovery schedule, but blend toward the conservative parent's radius and relocation fraction when existing swarm dispersion supplies substantial coverage. Compact swarms keep the stronger response to severe deterioration; dispersed swarms preserve more positional anchors. Memories remain reevaluated and velocities retained. This tests whether selective conservatism avoids the weaker parent's unconditional under-response; improvement requires evaluation.
